key.name: show-caps-lock
key.description: Whether to show the Caps Lock indicator in the panel.

key.name: show-num-lock
key.description: Whether to show the Num Lock indicator in the panel.

key.name: hide-when-off
key.description: Hide the indicator components entirely when the lock is turned off, rather than dimming them.

key.name: use-icons
key.description: Display system lock icons instead of text labels ("A" and "1").

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Display a system notification when Caps Lock or Num Lock is turned on or off.
